ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (isEmpty(payload)) [] else payload match { case is Array -> payload map ((row) -> { sku: trim(row.sku default ""), location: trim(row.location default ""), countedQty: trim(row.countedQty default ""), unitCost: trim(row.unitCost default ""), currency: trim(row.currency default ""), countedAt: trim(row.countedAt default ""), uom: trim(row.uom default "") }) case is String | Binary -> read(payload, "application/csv", { header: true, separator: "," }) map ((row) -> { sku: trim(row.sku default ""), location: trim(row.location default ""), countedQty: trim(row.countedQty default ""), unitCost: trim(row.unitCost default ""), currency: trim(row.currency default ""), countedAt: trim(row.countedAt default ""), uom: trim(row.uom default "") }) else -> [] }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { validRows: payload filter ((r) -> r.valid), invalidRows: payload filter ((r) -> !r.valid) }

%dw 2.0 output application/csv header=true --- payload.invalidRows map (item) -> { lineNumber: item.lineNumber, sku: item.sku, location: item.location, countedQty: item.countedQty, reasonCode: item.reasonCode, reason: item.reason }

logger.doc:name: No Rejects Logger
logger.message: #['[Correlation ID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] All rows passed validation successfully.']

set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload to Valid Rows Only
